checks: Depot validation distinguishes missing, malformed and unverified coordinates
A configured depot outside road coverage reports road connectivity, not missing coordinates
Dijkstra chooses the known shortest path and reconstructs every road node
Directed edges produce asymmetric distances and unreachable targets
Negative edge weights and invalid graph coordinates are rejected
One vehicle, feasible capacity, correct total load and exact timing
Multiple vehicles with different payloads respect each real capacity
Orders heavier than every vehicle remain unassigned with a load reason
Not enough vehicles or no selected shipper is reported without invented routes
Real service-area membership is required
Impossible deadlines are rejected without inventing a window start
Warehouse ready time is checked against departure without becoming a delivery window
Unknown parcel dimensions never become zero volume
Vehicle volume limits and unavailable personnel are enforced
Missing/invalid GPS and coordinates outside the graph are explicit
Vehicle routing profiles use separate directed road matrices
Return-to-depot is explicit and adds a reachable return leg
Every order is assigned at most once and duplicate manual membership is rejected
Manual and heuristic solutions are compared on exactly the same matrix and constraints
Arrival 13:50 VN waits ten minutes, starts 14:00 and departs 14:05
Arrival 14:10 after an earliest 14:00 starts immediately without waiting
Service start exactly at the deadline is feasible even when service finishes later
Service start after the deadline is unplanned automatically and rejected manually
Waiting at the first stop can invalidate a previously feasible next stop
Cheapest insertion and 2-opt retain the longer sequence required by delivery windows
Relocation cannot merge two simultaneous service-start windows into a shorter infeasible route
No requested time preserves the previous zero-wait timing and no synthetic deadline
A null deadline remains null while an existing requested time still causes waiting
Requested time later than deadline is explicitly invalid in automatic and manual planning
Invalid delivery windows remain explicit even when no vehicle was selected
Added stop timing round-trips and legacy JSON keeps new fields unknown rather than fabricated
Sub-minute waiting is preserved and totals exclude the return leg when requested
Preview request rejects duplicate IDs and past departure
OSM import respects oneway and explicit motor-vehicle restrictions
Downloaded OSM snapshot contains real roads and a reconstructable HCMC path
